meta.title: UTMB 2026 — Night Plan
meta.subtitle: CP11 → CP13 → Finish · Sat 29 → Sun 30 Aug · decide A/B/C by ~18:00 Sat

cp11Table.title: Getting to CP11 — pick a row by his pace (watch tracker from ~14:00)
rows: 0h42 — only if he is ≥45 min late
cp11Table.note: He is +N min at the last timing point → leave N min later. Keep ≥1 h buffer. At CP11 he eats 80 g — hand over 260 g carbs.

optionsTitle: CP11 → CP13 — pick ONE (crew leaves Champex ~19:15 after he goes)

options.label: Plan A — via home
options.risk: 3.5 h transit for 1h20 at home. If he slips +1 h, home window ≈ 20 min → flip to C.

options.label: Plan B — direct, skip Chamonix
steps: In Vallorcine — 3.5 h early. Dinner near the station (kitchens close early). Cold after midnight — pack layers.
options.risk: CP13 bag rides with you from base at 14:45 — 190 g carbs + his kit in your pack all day.

options.label: Plan C — via Chamonix, not home
options.tag: RECOMMENDED if CP13 bag is in the car
steps: Dinner in Chamonix. Repack from the car at Grépon.
options.risk: Hot food + bag from the car, no home round-trip, one connection. Leave the CP13 bag in the car Saturday morning.

cp13Band: 00:35 SUHA at CP13 Vallorcine — window 00:15–00:55. He eats 30 g, hand over 190 g carbs. Last leg: 4h04 to the finish. Cutoff SUN 13:15 — huge margin.

finish.title: CP13 → Finish
steps: He leaves ~00:55–01:05. Bus Vallorcine → Chamonix (every 30 min, runs until 12:30 Sun), arrive 01:30/02:00
Nap in the car at Grépon — set TWO alarms. Do not drive home for 1.5 h of sleep.
Be at the finish line, Chamonix centre. He finishes ~04:39.

footer: If he slips late, everything gets easier — buses run into Sunday noon. Passes: Swiss pass for Orsières/Champex/Trient legs; France pass for Vallorcine.
